comparison_notes: The frozen no-adapter model is the shared zero-update baseline. All four arms start at the identical function with zero feature gates; seeds vary paired minibatch order and finite-budget coverage.

Pointwise has 768 trainable parameters. EMA and learned history have 1537; fixed history has 1536 trainable plus one frozen alpha scalar. No dummy parameters. History versus pointwise includes additional capacity; EMA versus learned history matches count but not initialization of the filter, mathematical prior, conditioning or compute.

All history arms use independent local and history gates. GL uses Rust forward_history with K=32, step=1, initial alpha=0.5. EMA uses ordinary Torch operations with strictly-past weights (1-d)*d^(k-1), k=1..31, initial d=0.5, with d=sigmoid(logit_decay). Neither renormalizes truncated prefixes.

Primary contrasts: learned history minus EMA for fractional versus ordinary mixing; learned minus fixed history for order adaptation; fixed history minus pointwise and EMA minus pointwise for each history-plus-capacity change.
